summary: Telemetry default date ranges were reported as being calculated in the controller with current_time() plus strtotime().
why_it_matters: Ad-hoc date maths in controllers drifts from the UTC-first storage and site-timezone display rules that AIPS_DateTime centralises.
suggested_fix: Derive both the render and AJAX defaults from AIPS_DateTime.
resolution: Not reproducible on the current tree: render_page() and ajax_get_telemetry() already build their defaults with AIPS_DateTime::now()->toDisplay() and AIPS_DateTime::now()->advance('-29 days'). The file contains no current_time() or strtotime() call. Closed as already-fixed.
